messages.subject: Failure to launch
parts:
I have a fairly large and complex app that was working last week. I have made no changes since then, but when I run the app now nothing happens. The console shows "Listening on http://..." and the Rstudio window the app would be displayed in appears, but the whole window is gray. No error messages, and it just stays in this state until I close the program. Any idea what could be going on? I'm launching the app from my local desktop.

I'd really appreciate any help with this!

Ryan
